name: settings-gear-opens-flyout
description: Clicking the gear in the player's top dock row opens the settings flyout, and that flyout is the one on screen.

steps.name: hasVideo
steps.note: The dock gear is reachable before the stream is up, but a flyout opened over a dialog that has not loaded yet is not the behaviour under test.
playerSettingsButton is the gear at PlayerShell.cpp:346, wired to openSettings().

steps.name: widgetVisible
steps.note: openSettings() shows the flyout synchronously, so this only has to cover the click being delivered.

assertions.note: The flyout is constructed hidden (ShellWidgets.cpp:146 hide()), so widget_exists alone would pass on a build where the gear did nothing at all. The visibility read is what makes this fail when the click is dropped.

openSettings() calls dismissOverlay() first, so the two overlays are mutually exclusive. This is the assertion that says the gear opened the flyout and not the enhancement tree - without it, any overlay appearing would satisfy a bare 'something opened' reading.
